
```{r merge-6}
## In each imaging datasets:
## for every individual, with multiple imaging visits, make sure only one observation left within three month by keeping the one with minimum missingness

nic_cdes <- cleanImages_rmCloseScanes(nic_cdes)

nic_am_vols <- cleanImages_rmCloseScanes(nic_am_vols)

nic_pm_vols <- cleanImages_rmCloseScanes(nic_pm_vols)
```

## Final Merge

```{r merge-10}
## add the merged_images
cat("Info of previously merged dataset: ")
info(all,"e165_ID")
cat("\n")

final <- merge_with_info(
    df1name = "all",
    df2name = "merged_images",
    merge_cols = c("e165_ID","VISIT"),
    info_col = "e165_ID"
  )

```
